name: Sultan Mahmud Shah
bio: Petitions still find Mahmud after Ahmad receives the regalia. A warehouse keeper who acts on one answer may hear a different one from the other court.
notes: fact: Pires gives Mahmud the decision against Sequeira and puts him in the 1511 talks; Brown has him entrust the regalia to Ahmad before the fall and later resume rule (Pires II, pp. 254–259, 280; Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 163–171)
inference: The accounts do not settle his day-to-day authority in 1511; Birch’s reported death at Pao conflicts with Brown’s later sequence (people-factions.md §2; Birch III, pp. 143–144)
gameplay: Conflicting warehouse authorizations are invented (people-factions.md §2)
